text_blocks.snippet: Lillie's Clefairy ex is a prominent Basic Psychic-type Pokémon card featured in modern Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) sets like Scarlet & Violet: Journey Together and Ascended Heroes.
snippet_highlighted_words: a prominent Basic Psychic-type Pokémon card featured in modern Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) sets like Scarlet & Violet: Journey Together and Ascended Heroes

list.snippet: Ability — Fairy Zone: Changes the Weakness of each of your opponent's Dragon Pokémon in play to Psychic (applying ×2 damage).
Attack — Full Moon Rondo (Costs: 1 Psychic, 1 Colorless energy): Deals 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's).
Prize Rule: When a Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Journey Together: #56 (Double Rare), #173 (Ultra Rare), and #184 (Special Illustration Rare) on TCGplayer
Dragon Counter: Its Fairy Zone ability makes it a strong tech choice against popular Dragon-type threats like Dragapult ex by hitting them for weakness.
Bench Scaling: Full Moon Rondo can scale up to high damage outputs quickly if both player benches are filled out.
